item.title: Bridges & Brunch with Strasburg Scooter Tours — Sun Oct 11 — Strasburg Scooter Tours
item.description:
Experience a relaxing morning ride through the back roads of Amish Country in Lancaster County, PA. Along the way to a 19th century covered bridge, enjoy the scenery of rolling hills, breathtaking views, and our Amish neighbors going about their daily routines. Itinerary Duration: 1.5-2 hours Some of our past tours have included:
A guided tour of one of Lancaster County’s most beautiful covered bridges An opportunity for a close up of daily life in Amish Country $10 dining voucher to one of two of Strasburg’s favorites brunch spots, Casey Jones’ Restaurant and Speckled Hen*
And each trip is unique, so you never know what we might have in store for you! *Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that some of the food offerings on the tour may not be considered ‘Kosher.’ We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: The Statler Experience at American Music Theatre — Sun Oct 11, 3:00 PM — American Music Theatre
item.description: The Statler Experience brings the timeless harmonies of The Statler Brothers back to the stage in a heartfelt celebration featuring the next generation of Statler family talent: Wilson Fairchild (Wil & Langdon Reid) and Jack and Davis Reid. As sons and grandsons of original Statler Brothers members, these artists carry not only the sound — but the spirit — of one of country music’s most beloved vocal groups. Audiences will hear classic hits like “Flowers on the Wall,” “Bed of Rose’s,” “Do You Remember These,” and “Elizabeth,” delivered with the rich harmonies, warmth, and authenticity that defined the original quartet. Beyond the music, The Statler Experience offers personal stories, humor, and behind-the-scenes memories that connect generations of fans to the heart of the Statler legacy. item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Tue Oct 13, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

item.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman at Ephrata Performing Arts Center — Thu Oct 15 — Ephrata Performing Arts Center
item.description:
Seductive, haunting, and deeply moving, Kiss of the Spider Woman is a powerful musical that explores love, fantasy, and survival in the darkest of places. Set in a Latin American prison, the story follows two cellmates: Valentin, a political revolutionary, and Molina, a gay window dresser who escapes the brutal reality around them through the glamorous world of old films—embodied by the mysterious Spider Woman. As their unlikely bond deepens, dreams and truth blur in a tale of resilience, sacrifice, and the transformative power of connection. With a lush score by Kander and Ebb, Kiss of the Spider Woman is a bold, unforgettable theatrical experience.

item.title: Figure Drawing: Extended Pose Workshop with Evan Kitson at PCA&D — Sun Oct 18, 10:00 AM — Pennsylvania College of Art & Design – Center for Creative Exploration
item.description:
In this single session long-pose figure drawing workshop, artist, anatomist, and instructor Evan Kitson will guide you through the main stages of building a single drawing from the blank page to a resolved artwork.
Through lecture, demonstration, and personalized feedback at the drawing easel, you’ll learn how to navigate the timeless challenges of gesture, proportion, structure, mark-making and material use, while also studying the nude human figure through artistic anatomy and perception concepts. You’ll leave this workshop with a worked and well-observed figure drawing, and the many ideas and concepts surrounding its construction that you can then bring into your personal work at home. item.title: Evening Compline — Thu Oct 15, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.

item.title: 2026 PA Renaissance Faire Field Trip! — Sun Nov 29, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Lancaster Freethought Society We will be going on a field trip to the PA Renaissance Faire this year, on Sunday, November 29th! The event will run from 11am - 4:30pm!
Tickets for this event are approx. $30 per person. We will individually purchase our tickets, make sure you have selected the correct date in their 'box office'! I recommend that we all purchase tickets ahead of time so that we can all go on the same day and ensure that they are not sold out! Day of, we'll meet in the parking lot and enter as a group!
https://www.parenfaire.com
Sunday, November 29th 11:00am - 4:30pm
PA Renaissance Faire 2775 Lebanon Road, Manheim PA 17545
Source: Meetup: Lancaster Freethought Society

item.title: The 2026 Christmas Show: Winter Wonderland — Tue Dec 8 — American Music Theatre
item.description:
Step into the magic of the season with Winter Wonderland, American Music Theatre’s 2026 Christmas show! From a charming Bavarian village to the festive North Pole, this dazzling production features stunning sets, gorgeous costumes, and live performances of your favorite sacred and secular holiday songs. With our sensational cast, live orchestra, and even a visit from Santa, it’s a joyful experience for the whole family—and a holiday tradition for all!
Source: American Music Theatre

item.description:
Adults, Seniors
This stop is ONLY for seniors and employees at United Zion Retirement Community. At this stop, patrons can register for a library card, check out or return materials, and request holds for future stops.The materials at this stop are checked out for a full month (until the next BKM visit) and can be returned at any library within the system of Lancaster County.
